newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in March.
newsitem.headline: Italy has non-EU trade surplus in March.

text.p: Italy had a 3.373 trillion lire trade surplus with non-European Union countries in March, the national statistics office ISTAT said.
ITALY TRADE BALANCE (NON-EU) March 97 Feb 97 March 96
Cumulative yr to date +6.957 trln +3.584 trln +6.106 trln
Imports yr to date 33.110 trln 21.922 trln 34.018 trln
Exports yr to date 40.067 trln 25.506 trln 40.124 trln
Note: February 1997 figures were all slightly revised.
Istat gave the following breakdown for the trade balance with European Union countries for February.
Cumulative yr to date +1.761 trln +1.182 trln 1.826 trln
Note -- Istat said that Italy had a global trade surplus in February of 3.711 trillion lire against a surplus of 4.144 trillion lire in February 1996.
